title: Game Host Service Descriptor
description: Schema for the amitia-game-host/1 runtime/handshake ServiceDescriptor. This is distinct from plugin-host-spec.services[] (PluginServiceSpec), which binds a service to a runtime module via moduleId.

id.description: Unique service identifier within the plugin.

kind.description: Service execution model. amitia-game-host/1 exposes process-backed services only.

required.description: Whether this service is essential for plugin operation.

dependsOn.description: Service IDs this service depends on.

metadata.description: Extension metadata. Core logic must not depend on undefined fields.
